# Load libraries
```{r LOAD LIBRARIES, include=FALSE}
#Cargamos las librerías necesarias para el análisis.
library(tidyverse)

find_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  current <- normalizePath(start, mustWork = TRUE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(current, "metadata", "MURANUCI_sample_id_map.csv"))) {
      return(current)
    }
    parent <- dirname(current)
    if (identical(parent, current)) {
      stop("No se encontro metadata/MURANUCI_sample_id_map.csv desde ", start)
    }
    current <- parent
  }
}

project_root <- find_project_root()
metadata_dir <- file.path(project_root, "metadata")
tables_dir <- file.path(project_root, "results", "ARGs", "tables")
plots_dir <- file.path(project_root, "results", "ARGs", "figures")
dir.create(tables_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(plots_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

clinical_genes <- c(
  "blaKPC_3",
  "blaVIM_1",
  "blaCTX_M_9",
  "blaCTX_M_15",
  "blaCTX_M_55",
  "blaNDM_5",
  "blaOXA_48"
)

# Formato tipografico de genes para figuras: bla en cursiva y la variante como
# subindice. Los nombres internos usan guiones bajos y se muestran con guiones.
gene_plotmath_strings <- function(x) {
  map_chr(x, function(label) {
    if (is.na(label) || label == "") {
      return("")
    }

    if (!str_detect(label, "^bla")) {
      return(paste0("'", label, "'"))
    }

    gene_variant <- label %>%
      str_remove("^bla") %>%
      str_replace_all("_", "-")

    paste0("italic(bla)[plain('", gene_variant, "')]")
  })
}

gene_facet_labeller <- as_labeller(
  gene_plotmath_strings,
  default = label_parsed
)

# Variante en negrita para los encabezados del plot comparativo principal.
# Conserva bla en negrita cursiva y muestra también el alelo en negrita.
gene_bold_plotmath_strings <- function(x) {
  map_chr(x, function(label) {
    if (is.na(label) || label == "") {
      return("")
    }

    if (!str_detect(label, "^bla")) {
      return(paste0("bold('", label, "')"))
    }

    gene_variant <- label %>%
      str_remove("^bla") %>%
      str_replace_all("_", "-")

    paste0("bolditalic(bla)[bold('", gene_variant, "')]")
  })
}

gene_facet_bold_labeller <- as_labeller(
  gene_bold_plotmath_strings,
  default = label_parsed
)

gene_cell_plotmath_strings <- function(x) {
  map_chr(x, function(value) {
    if (is.na(value) || value == "") {
      return("")
    }

    expressions <- value %>%
      str_split(";\\s*") %>%
      .[[1]] %>%
      gene_plotmath_strings()

    if (length(expressions) == 1) {
      return(expressions)
    }

    reduce(
      expressions,
      function(upper, lower) paste0("atop(", upper, ",", lower, ")")
    )
  })
}

controls_list <- c(
  "Community-2",
  "COMUNITY-1",
  "CONTROL-DNA-2",
  "DNA-CONTROL-1",
  "Gut-1",
  "Gut-microbiome-2"
)

# Herramientas de funcscan utilizadas en todos los analisis principales.
funcscan_tools_primary <- c("ABRicate", "AMRFinderPlus")

normalise_sample_name <- function(x) {
  source_names <- str_remove(x, "\\..*$")
  mapped_names <- sample_id_newnames$name[
    match(source_names, sample_id_newnames$source_sample_id)
  ]
  coalesce(mapped_names, source_names)
}

# Numeric visit is the single visit key; W is used only for display.
week_plot_labels <- function(x) {
  factor(x, levels = 0:2, labels = paste0("W", 0:2))
}

sample_id_newnames <- read_csv(
  file.path(metadata_dir, "MURANUCI_sample_id_map.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(follow_up_week = as.integer(follow_up_week))

culture_metadata <- read_csv(
  file.path(metadata_dir, "MURANUCI_culture_metadata.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(follow_up_week = as.integer(follow_up_week))

stopifnot(
  !anyDuplicated(sample_id_newnames[c("patient_id", "follow_up_week")]),
  !anyDuplicated(sample_id_newnames$name),
  !anyDuplicated(culture_metadata[c("patient_id", "follow_up_week")]),
  all(sample_id_newnames$follow_up_week %in% 0:2),
  all(culture_metadata$follow_up_week %in% 0:2),
  nrow(anti_join(culture_metadata, sample_id_newnames,
                by = c("patient_id", "follow_up_week"))) == 0L
)

# Internal analysis links are retrieved from the private mapping only.
culture_wgs_reference <- culture_metadata %>%
  left_join(
    sample_id_newnames %>%
      select(patient_id, follow_up_week, name, sample),
    by = c("patient_id", "follow_up_week")
  )

add_patient_labels <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    select(-any_of(c("sample", "patient_id", "follow_up_week"))) %>%
    left_join(
      sample_id_newnames %>%
        select(name, sample, patient_id, follow_up_week),
      by = "name"
    ) %>%
    mutate(patient_id = factor(patient_id, levels = paste0("PAC", 1:8)))
}
```

# 1. ARIBA-ResFinder
```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE, fig.width=4, fig.height=3}
#cargar output ariba con resfinder
resfinder_summary <- read.delim(
  file.path(project_root, "results", "ARGs", "inputs", "ariba", "out_summary_resfinder.csv"),
  header = TRUE,
  sep = ","
)

#sacamos tabla solo con los matches
#resfinder_summary_MatchYes <- resfinder_summary %>% filter(if_any(ends_with(".match"), ~ . == "yes"))

ariba_summary_clean <- resfinder_summary %>% 
  mutate(name = str_remove(name, "^.*/run/")) %>%
  mutate(name = str_replace(name, "/.*tsv", ""))


# 1. Identificar cada columna .ref_seq con su columna .match
columnas_match <- names(ariba_summary_clean)[
  endsWith(names(ariba_summary_clean), ".match")
]
columnas_refseq <- names(ariba_summary_clean)[
  endsWith(names(ariba_summary_clean), ".ref_seq")
]

columnas_validas <- columnas_refseq[sapply(columnas_refseq, function(col) {
  sub(".ref_seq$", ".match", col) %in% columnas_match
})]

# 2. Pasar las parejas .match/.ref_seq a formato largo y conservar
#    explicitamente solo las detecciones .match == "yes".
ariba_hits_all <- map_dfr(columnas_validas, function(refseq_col) {
  match_col <- sub(".ref_seq$", ".match", refseq_col)
  
  tibble(
    name = ariba_summary_clean$name,
    cluster = sub(".ref_seq$", "", refseq_col),
    ariba_match = as.character(ariba_summary_clean[[match_col]]),
    resfinder_ref = as.character(ariba_summary_clean[[refseq_col]])
  )
}) %>%
  filter(
    str_to_lower(ariba_match) == "yes",
    !is.na(resfinder_ref),
    resfinder_ref != ""
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    AMR = str_extract(resfinder_ref, "^[^.]+")
  ) %>%
  distinct(name, cluster, resfinder_ref, AMR, .keep_all = TRUE)

# 3. Crear por separado el subconjunto de los siete alelos clinicos.
ariba_hits_clinical <- ariba_hits_all %>%
  filter(AMR %in% clinical_genes)

# 4. Preparar todas las muestras de ARIBA, incluidas las que no tienen
#    detecciones clinicas.
ariba_samples <- ariba_summary_clean %>%
  select(name) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(!name %in% controls_list) %>%
  mutate(name = normalise_sample_name(name)) %>%
  add_patient_labels()

# Aplicar a los hits la misma normalizacion de nombres usada para las muestras.
ariba_hits_all <- ariba_hits_all %>%
  mutate(name = normalise_sample_name(name))

ariba_hits_clinical <- ariba_hits_all %>%
  filter(AMR %in% clinical_genes)

# 5. Completar muestra x gen para representar tambien "Not Detected".
table_gather <- ariba_samples %>%
  tidyr::crossing(AMR = clinical_genes) %>%
  left_join(
    ariba_hits_clinical %>%
      distinct(name, AMR) %>%
      mutate(ariba = "Detected"),
    by = c("name", "AMR")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ariba = replace_na(ariba, "Not Detected"),
    ariba = factor(ariba, levels = c("Detected", "Not Detected"))
  )
```

# 2. nf-core/funcscan
```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE, fig.width=4, fig.height=3}
# ---------------------------------------------------
# 0) Cargar output de nf-core/funcscan
# ---------------------------------------------------
funcscan_arg <- readr::read_tsv(
  file.path(project_root, "results", "ARGs", "inputs", "funcscan", "hamronization_complete_summary_taxonomy.tsv.gz"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

names(funcscan_arg)


# ---------------------------------------------------
# 2) Preparar tabla limpia de funcscan
# ---------------------------------------------------
# Esta tabla conserva todos los hits reportados por las herramientas, sin
# exigir ARO ni aplicar filtros adicionales de identidad/cobertura.
funcscan_hits_all <- funcscan_arg %>%
  mutate(
    sample_id_original = sample_id,
    gene_symbol_original = gene_symbol,
    analysis_software_name_original = analysis_software_name,
    
    # Limpiar sample_id sin perder el valor original.
    name = sample_id,
    name = str_remove(name, "_retrieved-genes-.*\\.fargene$"),
    name = normalise_sample_name(name),
    
    # Formatear el nombre de la herramienta.
    tool = case_when(
      str_to_lower(analysis_software_name) == "abricate" ~ "ABRicate",
      str_to_lower(analysis_software_name) == "amrfinderplus" ~ "AMRFinderPlus",
      str_to_lower(analysis_software_name) == "rgi" ~ "RGI",
      str_to_lower(analysis_software_name) == "fargene" ~ "fARGene",
      TRUE ~ analysis_software_name
    ),
    
    # Crear un nombre comparable conservando gene_symbol_original.
    AMR = gene_symbol,
    AMR = str_replace_all(AMR, "-", "_"),
    AMR = str_replace_all(AMR, " ", "_"),
    
    # Para que RGI tipo CTX-M-15 pase a blaCTX_M_15
    AMR = case_when(
      str_detect(AMR, "^bla") ~ AMR,
      str_detect(AMR, "^(CTX_M|KPC|NDM|VIM|OXA)_") ~ paste0("bla", AMR),
      TRUE ~ AMR
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!name %in% controls_list) %>%
  filter(!is.na(AMR))

# ---------------------------------------------------
# 3) Filtrar genes AMR de interés
# ---------------------------------------------------
# Comparacion principal: solo ABRicate y AMRFinderPlus.

# Tabla detallada: conserva herramienta, contig, base de datos, calidad y
# taxonomia para los siete alelos clinicos.
funcscan_clinical_hits_long <- funcscan_hits_all %>%
  filter(
    tool %in% funcscan_tools_primary,
    AMR %in% clinical_genes
  ) %>%
  select(
    sample_id_original,
    name,
    tool,
    gene_symbol_original,
    AMR,
    reference_database_name,
    reference_database_version,
    reference_accession,
    contig_id,
    coverage_percentage,
    sequence_identity,
    taxid,
    rank_label,
    scientific_name,
    mmseqs_lineage_contig
  ) %>%
  distinct()

# Tabla de deteccion: una sola fila por muestra, herramienta y gen. Esto evita
# duplicar celdas del heatmap cuando un gen aparece en varios contigs o cuando
# la tabla taxonomica contiene varias filas para el mismo hit.
funcscan_clinical_detection_by_tool <- funcscan_clinical_hits_long %>%
  select(name, tool, AMR) %>%
  distinct()

# Comprobacion explicita de que solo entran los siete genes y las dos
# herramientas seleccionadas.
stopifnot(
  all(funcscan_clinical_detection_by_tool$tool %in% funcscan_tools_primary),
  all(funcscan_clinical_detection_by_tool$AMR %in% clinical_genes)
)


# ---------------------------------------------------
# 4) Lista completa de muestras
# ---------------------------------------------------
# Usamos exclusivamente las visitas clinicas registradas en metadatos.
# No se crean combinaciones paciente-semana que no fueron muestreadas.
clinical_sample_visits <- ariba_samples %>%
  filter(!is.na(patient_id), !is.na(follow_up_week)) %>%
  semi_join(
    sample_id_newnames,
    by = c("patient_id", "follow_up_week")
  ) %>%
  distinct(name, sample, patient_id, follow_up_week)

all_samples_funcscan <- clinical_sample_visits %>%
  select(name) %>%
  distinct()


# ---------------------------------------------------
# 5) Reutilizar las visitas vinculadas al mapa privado
# ---------------------------------------------------

all_samples_funcscan_parsed <- clinical_sample_visits


# ---------------------------------------------------
# 6) Genes y tools a pintar
# ---------------------------------------------------

genes_to_plot_funcscan <- funcscan_clinical_detection_by_tool %>%
  distinct(AMR) %>%
  arrange(AMR) %>%
  pull(AMR)

tools_to_plot_funcscan <- funcscan_clinical_detection_by_tool %>%
  distinct(tool) %>%
  arrange(tool) %>%
  pull(tool)


# ---------------------------------------------------
# 7) Crear tabla presencia/ausencia por tool
# ---------------------------------------------------

table_gather_funcscan_by_tool <- all_samples_funcscan_parsed %>%
  tidyr::crossing(
    tool = tools_to_plot_funcscan,
    AMR = genes_to_plot_funcscan
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    funcscan_clinical_detection_by_tool %>%
      mutate(funcscan = "Detected"),
    by = c("name", "tool", "AMR")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    funcscan = replace_na(funcscan, "Not Detected"),
    funcscan = factor(funcscan, levels = c("Detected", "Not Detected")),
    patient_id = factor(patient_id, levels = paste0("PAC", 1:8)),
    follow_up_week = as.integer(follow_up_week),
    tool = factor(
      tool,
      levels = funcscan_tools_primary
    )
  )
```

# 3. Comparacion ARIBA frente a funcscan

## Plot: ARIBA vs duncscan
```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}

# ---------------------------------------------------
# 1) Preparar las detecciones de ARIBA
# ---------------------------------------------------

ariba_detection <- ariba_hits_clinical %>%
  group_by(name, AMR) %>%
  summarise(
    ariba_detected = TRUE,
    ariba_resfinder_refs = paste(
      sort(unique(resfinder_ref)),
      collapse = "; "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------
# 2) Preparar ABRicate y AMRFinderPlus por separado
# ---------------------------------------------------

funcscan_detection <- funcscan_clinical_hits_long %>%
  group_by(name, AMR) %>%
  summarise(
    abricate_detected = any(tool == "ABRicate"),
    amrfinderplus_detected = any(tool == "AMRFinderPlus"),
    abricate_gene_symbols = paste(
      sort(unique(gene_symbol_original[tool == "ABRicate"])),
      collapse = "; "
    ),
    amrfinderplus_gene_symbols = paste(
      sort(unique(gene_symbol_original[tool == "AMRFinderPlus"])),
      collapse = "; "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------
# 3) Crear una fila para cada visita real y cada uno de los siete genes
# ---------------------------------------------------

clinical_ARG_detection_by_method <- clinical_sample_visits %>%
  tidyr::crossing(AMR = clinical_genes) %>%
  left_join(
    ariba_detection,
    by = c("name", "AMR")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    funcscan_detection,
    by = c("name", "AMR")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ariba_detected = replace_na(ariba_detected, FALSE),
    abricate_detected = replace_na(abricate_detected, FALSE),
    amrfinderplus_detected = replace_na(amrfinderplus_detected, FALSE),
    ariba_resfinder_refs = replace_na(ariba_resfinder_refs, ""),
    abricate_gene_symbols = replace_na(abricate_gene_symbols, ""),
    amrfinderplus_gene_symbols = replace_na(amrfinderplus_gene_symbols, ""),
    
    funcscan_detected = abricate_detected | amrfinderplus_detected,
    funcscan_tools_detected = case_when(
      abricate_detected & amrfinderplus_detected ~ "ABRicate; AMRFinderPlus",
      abricate_detected ~ "ABRicate",
      amrfinderplus_detected ~ "AMRFinderPlus",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    
    detection_category = case_when(
      ariba_detected & funcscan_detected ~ "ARIBA + funcscan",
      ariba_detected & !funcscan_detected ~ "ARIBA only",
      !ariba_detected & funcscan_detected ~ "Funcscan only",
      TRUE ~ "Not detected"
    ),
    
    detection_category = factor(
      detection_category,
      levels = c(
        "ARIBA + funcscan",
        "ARIBA only",
        "Funcscan only",
        "Not detected"
      )
    ),
    
    AMR_key = AMR,
    patient_id = factor(patient_id, levels = paste0("PAC", 1:8)),
    follow_up_week = as.integer(follow_up_week)
  )

# Comprobaciones: 13 visitas x 7 genes, sin duplicados muestra-gen.
stopifnot(
  nrow(clinical_ARG_detection_by_method) ==
    nrow(clinical_sample_visits) * length(clinical_genes),
  !anyDuplicated(
    clinical_ARG_detection_by_method[c("name", "AMR")]
  )
)

write_csv(
  clinical_ARG_detection_by_method,
  file.path(tables_dir, "clinical_ARG_detection_by_method.csv")
)
```

## Plot: ARIBA vs each funcscan tool
```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
# ---------------------------------------------------
# 1) Tools de funcscan a comparar
# ---------------------------------------------------

funcscan_tools_for_comparison <- funcscan_tools_primary


# ---------------------------------------------------
# 2) Preparar ARIBA: solo detecciones reales
# ---------------------------------------------------

ariba_hits <- table_gather %>%
  filter(!sample %in% c(
    "Community-2",
    "COMUNITY-1",
    "CONTROL-DNA-2",
    "DNA-CONTROL-1",
    "Gut-1",
    "Gut-microbiome-2"
  )) %>%
  filter(ariba == "Detected") %>%
  mutate(
    AMR_key = AMR,
    AMR_key = str_replace_all(AMR_key, "-", "_"),
    AMR_key = str_replace_all(AMR_key, " ", "_")
  ) %>%
  select(name, sample, follow_up_week, AMR_ariba = AMR, AMR_key) %>%
  distinct()


# ---------------------------------------------------
# 3) Preparar funcscan: solo detecciones reales por tool
# ---------------------------------------------------

funcscan_hits_by_tool <- funcscan_clinical_detection_by_tool %>%
  filter(tool %in% funcscan_tools_for_comparison) %>%
  mutate(
    AMR_key = AMR,
    AMR_key = str_replace_all(AMR_key, "-", "_"),
    AMR_key = str_replace_all(AMR_key, " ", "_")
  ) %>%
  select(name, tool, AMR_funcscan = AMR, AMR_key) %>%
  distinct()


# ---------------------------------------------------
# 4) Crear tabla base solo con genes reales de cada tool
# ---------------------------------------------------
# Esto evita que todas las tools tengan artificialmente los mismos genes.

tool_specific_genes <- funcscan_hits_by_tool %>%
  distinct(tool, AMR_key, AMR_funcscan)


# ---------------------------------------------------
# 5) Añadir muestra y visita numerica a las combinaciones
# ---------------------------------------------------

samples_for_plot <- table_gather %>%
  filter(!sample %in% c(
    "Community-2",
    "COMUNITY-1",
    "CONTROL-DNA-2",
    "DNA-CONTROL-1",
    "Gut-1",
    "Gut-microbiome-2"
  )) %>%
  select(name, sample, patient_id, follow_up_week) %>%
  distinct()


comparison_by_tool <- samples_for_plot %>%
  tidyr::crossing(tool_specific_genes) %>%
  left_join(
    ariba_hits %>%
      mutate(ariba_detected = TRUE) %>%
      select(name, AMR_key, ariba_detected),
    by = c("name", "AMR_key")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    funcscan_hits_by_tool %>%
      mutate(tool_detected = TRUE) %>%
      select(name, tool, AMR_key, tool_detected),
    by = c("name", "tool", "AMR_key")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ariba_detected = replace_na(ariba_detected, FALSE),
    tool_detected = replace_na(tool_detected, FALSE),
    
    detection_category = case_when(
      ariba_detected & tool_detected ~ "ARIBA + funcscan",
      ariba_detected & !tool_detected ~ "ARIBA only",
      !ariba_detected & tool_detected ~ "Funcscan only",
      TRUE ~ "Not detected"
    ),
    
    detection_category = factor(
      detection_category,
      levels = c("ARIBA + funcscan", "ARIBA only", "Funcscan only", "Not detected")
    ),
    
    patient_id = factor(patient_id, levels = paste0("PAC", 1:8)),
    follow_up_week = as.integer(follow_up_week),
    tool = factor(tool, levels = funcscan_tools_for_comparison)
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------
# 6) Plot
# ---------------------------------------------------
detection_cols <- c(
  "ARIBA + funcscan" = "#CC79A7",
  "ARIBA only" = "#D55E00",
  "Funcscan only" = "#56B4E9",
  "Not detected" = "#E0E0E0"
)

legend_dummy <- tibble(
```

# 4. Culturomica frente a metagenomica
```{r}
collapse_genes <- function(x) {
  x <- sort(unique(as.character(x)))
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]
  if (length(x) == 0) "None" else paste(x, collapse = "; ")
}

normalise_arg_name_culture <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_trim() %>%
    na_if("") %>%
    na_if("-") %>%
    na_if("nd") %>%
    str_replace_all("[[:space:]]+", "") %>%
    str_replace_all("-", "_")
}

culture_table <- culture_wgs_reference %>%
  mutate(
    culture_result = culture_species,
    culture_ARG_status = case_when(
      culture_ARGs_raw == "-" ~ "no_ARG_reported",
      str_to_lower(culture_ARGs_raw) == "nd" ~ "unknown",
      TRUE ~ "available"
    ),
    culture_expected_genes = map_chr(
      str_split(culture_ARGs_raw, ";"),
      ~ collapse_genes(normalise_arg_name_culture(.x))
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    name, sample, follow_up_week, culture_result,
    province, ST,
    culture_ARGs_raw, culture_ARG_status, culture_expected_genes
  )

# Genes informados explicitamente en los aislados de cultivo. Los valores "-"
# y "nd" no se convierten en genes ausentes.
culture_reported_genes <- culture_wgs_reference %>%
  filter(
    culture_ARGs_raw != "-",
    str_to_lower(culture_ARGs_raw) != "nd"
  ) %>%
  separate_rows(culture_ARGs_raw, sep = ";") %>%
  transmute(
    name,
    AMR = normalise_arg_name_culture(culture_ARGs_raw),
    culture_gene_reported = TRUE
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(AMR)) %>%
  distinct()

# Una fila por cada visita real de cultivo y cada gen clinico.
culture_clinical_ARG_status <- culture_table %>%
  tidyr::crossing(AMR = clinical_genes) %>%
  left_join(
    culture_reported_genes,
    by = c("name", "AMR")
  ) %>%
  add_patient_labels() %>%
  mutate(
    culture_gene_reported = replace_na(culture_gene_reported, FALSE),
    culture_gene_status = case_when(
      str_detect(culture_result, regex("^NEGATIVA$", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~
        "Negative culture",
      culture_ARG_status == "unknown" ~
        "Not determined",
      culture_gene_reported ~
        "Reported",
      TRUE ~
        "Not reported"
    ),
    culture_gene_status = factor(
      culture_gene_status,
      levels = c(
        "Reported",
        "Not reported",
        "Negative culture",
        "Not determined"
      )
    )
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(culture_clinical_ARG_status) ==
    nrow(culture_table) * length(clinical_genes),
  !anyDuplicated(culture_clinical_ARG_status[c("name", "AMR")])
)

# write_csv(
#   culture_clinical_ARG_status,
#   file.path(tables_dir, "culture_clinical_ARG_status.csv")
# )

# Union descriptiva cultivo-metagenomica. No se asignan aqui categorias de
# concordancia o discordancia.
clinical_ARG_culture_metagenomics_by_method <-
  culture_clinical_ARG_status %>%
  select(
    name,
    sample,
    patient_id,
    follow_up_week,
    culture_result,
    culture_ARGs_raw,
    AMR,
    culture_gene_status
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    clinical_ARG_detection_by_method %>%
      select(
        name,
        AMR,
        ariba_detected,
        abricate_detected,
        amrfinderplus_detected,
        funcscan_detected,
        detection_category,
        ariba_resfinder_refs,
        abricate_gene_symbols,
        amrfinderplus_gene_symbols
      ),
    by = c("name", "AMR")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    metagenomic_detected = ariba_detected | funcscan_detected,
    culture_metagenomics_interpretation = case_when(
      culture_gene_status == "Reported" & metagenomic_detected ~
        "Culture-reported ARG detected by metagenomics",
      culture_gene_status == "Reported" & !metagenomic_detected ~
        "Culture-reported ARG not detected by metagenomics",
      culture_gene_status == "Not reported" & metagenomic_detected ~
        "Metagenomic ARG not reported in culture metadata",
      culture_gene_status == "Not reported" & !metagenomic_detected ~
        "ARG neither reported nor detected",
      culture_gene_status == "Negative culture" & metagenomic_detected ~
        "Negative culture; metagenomic ARG detected",
      culture_gene_status == "Negative culture" & !metagenomic_detected ~
        "Negative culture; no metagenomic ARG detected",
      culture_gene_status == "Not determined" ~
        "Culture ARG not determined",
      TRUE ~
        "Check manually"
    )
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(clinical_ARG_culture_metagenomics_by_method) ==
    nrow(culture_clinical_ARG_status),
  !anyNA(
    clinical_ARG_culture_metagenomics_by_method$ariba_detected
  ),
  !anyNA(
    clinical_ARG_culture_metagenomics_by_method$funcscan_detected
  )
)

write_csv(
  clinical_ARG_culture_metagenomics_by_method,
  file.path(
    tables_dir,
    "clinical_ARG_culture_metagenomics_by_method.csv"
  )
)

```

## Taxones y ARG clinicos

Esta comparacion responde a dos preguntas distintas:

1. Si la especie aislada por cultivo aparece en el perfil taxonomico de la
   muestra metagenomica.
2. Si los ARG comunicados para el aislado se detectan mediante ARIBA o mediante
   las herramientas principales de funcscan (ABRicate/AMRFinderPlus).

Los cultivos negativos y los ARG marcados como `nd` no se interpretan como
ausencias de taxones o genes, respectivamente.

```{r culture-vs-metagenomics-summary}
# Resumir los siete ARG clinicos por visita. Las comparaciones solo se hacen
# para las 13 visitas que realmente tienen metadatos de cultivo.
culture_metagenomics_ARG_summary <-
  clinical_ARG_culture_metagenomics_by_method %>%
  group_by(name, patient_id, follow_up_week) %>%
  summarise(
    culture_reported_ARGs =
      collapse_genes(AMR[culture_gene_status == "Reported"]),
    metagenomic_detected_ARGs =
      collapse_genes(AMR[metagenomic_detected]),
    culture_ARGs_recovered =
      collapse_genes(
        AMR[culture_gene_status == "Reported" & metagenomic_detected]
      ),
    culture_ARGs_not_recovered =
      collapse_genes(
        AMR[culture_gene_status == "Reported" & !metagenomic_detected]
      ),
    additional_metagenomic_ARGs =
      collapse_genes(
        AMR[culture_gene_status == "Not reported" & metagenomic_detected]
      ),
    culture_ARG_information = case_when(
      any(culture_gene_status == "Not determined") ~ "Not determined",
      any(culture_gene_status == "Negative culture") ~ "Negative culture",
      TRUE ~ "Available"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r culture-vs-metagenomics-taxonomy}
clinically_relevant_taxa_all <- read_csv(
  file.path(
    project_root,
    "results",
    "TAX-TAXPROFILER",
    "R",
    "clinically_relevant_taxa_all.csv"
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# E. cloacae, E. hormaechei y P. mirabilis se comparan a nivel de especie.
# El panel taxonomico clinico habitual agrupa Enterobacter dentro del complejo
# E. cloacae y Proteus a nivel de genero, por lo que estas filas se recuperan
# directamente del informe completo de Kraken2/Bracken.
taxonomy_report_for_culture <- read_tsv(
  file.path(
    project_root,
    "results",
    "TAX-TAXPROFILER",
    "bracken",
    "table_import_braken_report.csv"
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    name = Sample %>%
      str_remove("_pe_run1_db2\\.bracken\\.kraken2\\.report_bracken_species\\.txt$") %>%
      normalise_sample_name()
  )

species_level_metagenomic_profile <- taxonomy_report_for_culture %>%
  filter(
    TaxRank == "S",
    Name2 %in% c(
      "Enterobacter cloacae",
      "Enterobacter hormaechei",
      "Proteus mirabilis"
    )
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    name,
    metagenomic_taxon = Name2,
    culture_taxon_reads = Reads
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    taxonomy_report_for_culture %>%
      filter(TaxRank == "D", Name2 == "Bacteria") %>%
      transmute(name, total_bacterial_reads = Reads),
    by = "name"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    culture_taxon_percent_total_bacteria =
      100 * culture_taxon_reads / total_bacterial_reads
  ) %>%
  select(-total_bacterial_reads)

culture_taxonomy_profiles <- bind_rows(
  clinically_relevant_taxa_all %>%
    transmute(
      name,
      metagenomic_taxon = clinically_relevant_taxon,
      culture_taxon_reads = taxon_reads,
      culture_taxon_percent_total_bacteria = taxon_percent_total_bacteria
    ),
  species_level_metagenomic_profile
)

# Correspondencia explicita entre la identificacion del cultivo y las
# categorias usadas en el perfil taxonomico metagenomico.
culture_taxon_key <- tribble(
  ~culture_species,              ~metagenomic_taxon,
  "Enterobacter cloacae",        "Enterobacter cloacae",
  "Enterobacter hormaechei",     "Enterobacter hormaechei",
  "Klebsiella pneumoniae",       "Klebsiella pneumoniae",
  "Proteus mirabilis",           "Proteus mirabilis",
  "Escherichia coli",            "Escherichia coli"
)

metagenomic_taxa_by_sample <- clinically_relevant_taxa_all %>%
  filter(taxon_reads > 0) %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  summarise(
    metagenomic_detected_taxa =
      collapse_genes(clinically_relevant_taxon),
    metagenomic_dominant_taxon =
      clinically_relevant_taxon[which.max(taxon_reads)],
    dominant_taxon_percent_total_bacteria =
      taxon_percent_total_bacteria[which.max(taxon_reads)],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

culture_metagenomics_taxonomy <- culture_wgs_reference %>%
  left_join(culture_taxon_key, by = "culture_species") %>%
  left_join(metagenomic_taxa_by_sample, by = "name") %>%
  left_join(
    culture_taxonomy_profiles %>%
      filter(culture_taxon_reads > 0),
    by = c("name", "metagenomic_taxon")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    culture_taxon_status = case_when(
      str_detect(culture_species, regex("^NEGATIVA$", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~
        "Negative culture",
      is.na(metagenomic_taxon) ~
        "Taxon mapping not available",
      !is.na(culture_taxon_reads) ~
        "Culture species detected by metagenomics",
      TRUE ~
        "Culture species not detected by metagenomics"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(patient_id, follow_up_week)

stopifnot(
  nrow(culture_metagenomics_taxonomy) == nrow(culture_wgs_reference),
  !anyDuplicated(culture_metagenomics_taxonomy$name)
)

write_csv(
  culture_metagenomics_taxonomy,
  file.path(tables_dir, "culture_vs_metagenomics_taxonomy.csv")
)

# Tabla final, una fila por visita, que conserva por separado el resultado
# taxonomico y el resultado de los ARG.
culture_vs_metagenomics_master <- culture_metagenomics_taxonomy %>%
  left_join(
    culture_metagenomics_ARG_summary,
    by = c("name", "patient_id", "follow_up_week")
  ) %>%
  select(
    patient_id,
    follow_up_week,
    name,
    province,
    culture_species,
    ST,
    culture_ARGs_raw,
    metagenomic_taxon,
    culture_taxon_status,
    culture_taxon_reads,
    culture_taxon_percent_total_bacteria,
    metagenomic_dominant_taxon,
    dominant_taxon_percent_total_bacteria,
    culture_reported_ARGs,
    metagenomic_detected_ARGs,
    culture_ARGs_recovered,
    culture_ARGs_not_recovered,
    additional_metagenomic_ARGs,
    culture_ARG_information
  )
```

```{r culture-vs-metagenomics-heatmap, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=3}
sample_levels_culture <- culture_wgs_reference %>%
  arrange(
    readr::parse_number(patient_id),
    follow_up_week
  ) %>%
  transmute(sample_label = paste(patient_id, week_plot_labels(follow_up_week), sep = "\n")) %>%
  pull(sample_label)

# La figura separa dos dimensiones:
# 1) si el taxon/ARG fue comunicado por cultivo;
# 2) si ese hallazgo fue recuperado por metagenomica y mediante que metodo.
# Se completa la matriz para distinguir explicitamente "no comunicado" de
# "no determinado" y de un verdadero hallazgo de cultivo no recuperado.

taxa_features_culture <- culture_metagenomics_taxonomy %>%
  filter(culture_taxon_status != "Negative culture") %>%
  distinct(culture_species) %>%
  arrange(culture_species) %>%
  pull(culture_species)

taxa_heatmap <- culture_wgs_reference %>%
  select(name, patient_id, follow_up_week) %>%
  tidyr::crossing(feature = taxa_features_culture) %>%
  left_join(
    culture_metagenomics_taxonomy %>%
      select(name, culture_species, culture_taxon_status),
    by = "name"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_label = paste(patient_id, week_plot_labels(follow_up_week), sep = "\n"),
    feature_group = "Cultured taxon",
    culture_status = if_else(
      culture_taxon_status != "Negative culture" &
        feature == culture_species,
      "Reported by culture",
      "Not reported by culture"
    ),
    metagenomic_status = case_when(
      culture_status == "Reported by culture" &
        culture_taxon_status == "Culture species detected by metagenomics" ~
        "Recovered cultured taxon",
      culture_status == "Reported by culture" ~
        "Not recovered by metagenomics",
      TRUE ~
        "Not reported by culture"
    ),
    cell_label = case_when(
      metagenomic_status == "Recovered cultured taxon" ~ "",
      metagenomic_status == "Not recovered by metagenomics" ~ "",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

ARG_features_culture <- clinical_ARG_culture_metagenomics_by_method %>%
  filter(culture_gene_status == "Reported") %>%
  distinct(AMR) %>%
  arrange(AMR) %>%
  pull(AMR)

ARG_heatmap <- clinical_ARG_culture_metagenomics_by_method %>%
  filter(AMR %in% ARG_features_culture) %>%
  transmute(
    sample_label = paste(patient_id, week_plot_labels(follow_up_week), sep = "\n"),
    feature_group = "Culture-reported ARG",
    feature = AMR,
    culture_status = case_when(
      culture_gene_status == "Reported" ~ "Reported by culture",
      culture_gene_status %in% c("Not determined", "Negative culture") ~
        "Not determined",
      TRUE ~ "Not reported by culture"
    ),
    metagenomic_status = case_when(
      culture_status == "Not determined" ~ "Not determined",
      culture_status == "Not reported by culture" ~
        "Not reported by culture",
      ariba_detected & funcscan_detected ~
        "Recovered by ARIBA + funcscan",
      ariba_detected ~
        "Recovered by ARIBA only",
      funcscan_detected ~
        "Recovered by funcscan only",
      TRUE ~
        "Not recovered by metagenomics"
    ),
    cell_label = case_when(
      culture_status == "Not determined" ~ "×",
      metagenomic_status == "Recovered by ARIBA + funcscan" ~ "A+F",
      metagenomic_status == "Recovered by ARIBA only" ~ "",
      metagenomic_status == "Recovered by funcscan only" ~ "F",
      metagenomic_status == "Not recovered by metagenomics" ~ "",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

culture_metagenomics_heatmap <- bind_rows(taxa_heatmap, ARG_heatmap) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_label = factor(sample_label, levels = sample_levels_culture),
    # ggplot dibuja los niveles del eje Y de abajo arriba. Se invierte aqui
    # para que taxones y, especialmente, ARG se lean alfabeticamente de
    # arriba abajo dentro de cada panel.
    feature = factor(
      feature,
      levels = rev(c(
        sort(unique(taxa_heatmap$feature)),
        sort(unique(ARG_heatmap$feature))
      ))
    ),
    feature_group = factor(
      feature_group,
      levels = c("Cultured taxon", "Culture-reported ARG")
    ),
    culture_status = factor(
      culture_status,
      levels = c(
        "Reported by culture",
        "Not reported by culture",
        "Not determined"
      )
    ),
    metagenomic_status = factor(
      metagenomic_status,
      levels = c(
        "Recovered cultured taxon",
        "Recovered by ARIBA + funcscan",
        "Recovered by ARIBA only",
        "Recovered by funcscan only",
        "Not recovered by metagenomics",
        "Not reported by culture",
        "Not determined"
      )
    )
  )

# Etiquetas del eje Y: nombres bacterianos en cursiva y ARG en texto normal.
culture_metagenomics_y_labels <- function(x) {
  label_expressions <- map_chr(x, function(label) {
    if (label %in% taxa_features_culture) {
      paste0("italic('", label, "')")
    } else if (str_detect(label, "^bla")) {
      gene_plotmath_strings(label)
    } else {
      paste0("'", label, "'")
    }
  })

  parse(text = label_expressions)
}
```

# 5. Metagenomica frente a culturomica

## Plot inverso: beta-lactamasas detectadas por metagenomica y no por cultivo

Se incluyen las familias: KPC, TEM, SHV, CTX-M y GES (clase A); VIM, IMP y
NDM (clase B); AmpC (clase C); y las variantes OXA-48, OXA-181, OXA-232,
OXA-244, OXA-245, OXA-162, OXA-204, OXA-370 y OXA-484 (clase D). Las
variantes se conservan en la etiqueta de cada celda. Las visitas cuyo resultado
de ARG en cultivo es `nd` se excluyen porque no permiten afirmar que el gen no
estuviera presente en el aislado.

```{r metagenomics-not-culture-beta-lactamases, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
oxa_variants_for_inverse_comparison <- c(
  "48", "181", "232", "244", "245", "162", "204", "370", "484"
)

oxa_pattern_for_inverse_comparison <- paste0(
  "OXA[-_ ]?(",
  paste(oxa_variants_for_inverse_comparison, collapse = "|"),
  ")([^0-9]|$)"
)

classify_beta_lactamase_family <- function(x) {
  x_upper <- str_to_upper(replace_na(as.character(x), ""))

  case_when(
    str_detect(x_upper, "CTX[-_ ]?M") ~ "CTX-M",
    str_detect(x_upper, "KPC") ~ "KPC",
    str_detect(x_upper, "TEM") ~ "TEM",
    str_detect(x_upper, "SHV") ~ "SHV",
    str_detect(x_upper, "GES") ~ "GES",
    str_detect(x_upper, "VIM") ~ "VIM",
    str_detect(x_upper, "IMP") ~ "IMP",
    str_detect(x_upper, "NDM") ~ "NDM",
    str_detect(x_upper, "AMPC") ~ "AmpC",
    str_detect(x_upper, oxa_pattern_for_inverse_comparison) ~ "OXA",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

beta_lactamase_class <- function(family) {
  case_when(
    family %in% c("KPC", "TEM", "SHV", "CTX-M", "GES") ~ "Class A",
    family %in% c("VIM", "IMP", "NDM") ~ "Class B",
    family == "AmpC" ~ "Class C",
    family == "OXA" ~ "Class D",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

canonical_beta_lactamase_variant <- function(x, family) {
  variant <- x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    str_remove(regex("^bla", ignore_case = TRUE)) %>%
    str_replace_all("_", "-") %>%
    str_replace_all("[[:space:]]+", "-") %>%
    str_replace_all("-+", "-") %>%
    str_to_upper()

  if_else(
    family == "AmpC",
    str_replace(variant, "^AMPC", "AmpC"),
    paste0("bla", variant)
  )
}

beta_lactamase_family_levels <- c(
  "KPC", "TEM", "SHV", "CTX-M", "GES",
  "VIM", "IMP", "NDM",
  "AmpC",
  "OXA"
)

sample_levels_inverse <- culture_wgs_reference %>%

# Funcscan: solo las dos herramientas principales, sin exigir ARO.
funcscan_lab_beta_hits <- funcscan_hits_all %>%

    beta_lactamase_family =

ariba_lab_beta_hits <- ariba_hits_all %>%
  mutate(
    native_variant = AMR,
    beta_lactamase_family =
      classify_beta_lactamase_family(native_variant),
    variant = canonical_beta_lactamase_variant(
      native_variant,
      beta_lactamase_family
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(beta_lactamase_family)) %>%
  semi_join(
    clinical_sample_visits %>% select(name),
    by = "name"
  ) %>%
  distinct(name, beta_lactamase_family, variant)

# Presencia por familia y metodo.
metagenomic_beta_family_detection <- full_join(
  ariba_lab_beta_hits %>%
    distinct(name, beta_lactamase_family) %>%
    mutate(ariba_detected = TRUE),
  funcscan_lab_beta_hits %>%
    distinct(name, beta_lactamase_family) %>%
    mutate(funcscan_detected = TRUE),
  by = c("name", "beta_lactamase_family")
) %>%
  mutate(
    ariba_detected = replace_na(ariba_detected, FALSE),
    funcscan_detected = replace_na(funcscan_detected, FALSE)
  )

# Unificar los nombres equivalentes comunicados por distintas herramientas.
# Si hay una variante concreta, se omite la llamada generica de la familia.
metagenomic_beta_variants <- bind_rows(
  ariba_lab_beta_hits %>%
    select(name, beta_lactamase_family, variant),
  funcscan_lab_beta_hits %>%
    select(name, beta_lactamase_family, variant)
) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(name, beta_lactamase_family) %>%
  mutate(
    generic_variant = paste0("bla", str_to_upper(beta_lactamase_family)),
    has_specific_variant = any(
      variant != generic_variant |
        beta_lactamase_family %in% c("AmpC", "OXA")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !has_specific_variant |
      variant != generic_variant |
      beta_lactamase_family %in% c("AmpC", "OXA")
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    metagenomic_variants =
      paste(sort(unique(variant)), collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Familias explicitamente comunicadas en los metadatos de cultivo.
culture_reported_beta_families <- culture_wgs_reference %>%
  filter(
    culture_ARGs_raw != "-",
    str_to_lower(culture_ARGs_raw) != "nd"
  ) %>%
  separate_rows(culture_ARGs_raw, sep = ";") %>%
  transmute(
    name,
    beta_lactamase_family =
      classify_beta_lactamase_family(culture_ARGs_raw),
    culture_reported = TRUE
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(beta_lactamase_family)) %>%
  distinct()

metagenomics_not_culture_beta_lactamases <-
  metagenomic_beta_family_detection %>%
  left_join(
    metagenomic_beta_variants,
    by = c("name", "beta_lactamase_family")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    culture_wgs_reference %>%
      select(
        name,
        patient_id,
        follow_up_week,
        culture_species,
        culture_ARGs_raw
      ),
    by = "name"
  ) %>%
  # nd significa que el perfil de ARG del cultivo no fue determinado.
  filter(str_to_lower(culture_ARGs_raw) != "nd") %>%
  left_join(
    culture_reported_beta_families,
    by = c("name", "beta_lactamase_family")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    culture_reported = replace_na(culture_reported, FALSE),
    detection_source = case_when(
      ariba_detected & funcscan_detected ~ "ARIBA + funcscan",
      ariba_detected ~ "ARIBA only",
      funcscan_detected ~ "Funcscan only"
    ),
    beta_lactamase_class =
      beta_lactamase_class(beta_lactamase_family)
  ) %>%
  filter(!culture_reported) %>%
  arrange(
    patient_id,
    follow_up_week,
    match(beta_lactamase_family, beta_lactamase_family_levels)
  )

write_csv(
```

# 6. Contexto taxonomico de los ARG clinicos en contigs
```{r clinical-arg-taxonomic-context}
rank_priority <- c(
  "species" = 8,
  "genus" = 7,
  "family" = 6,
  "order" = 5,
  "class" = 4,
  "phylum" = 3,
  "superkingdom" = 2,
  "no rank" = 1
)

# Una fila por hit de ARG antes de añadir la taxonomia. Solo se incluyen las
# dos herramientas principales y los siete genes clinicos.
arg_hits <- funcscan_clinical_hits_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(contig_id), contig_id != "") %>%
  select(
    name,
    contig_id,
    ARG = AMR,
    tool,
    gene_symbol = gene_symbol_original,
    reference_database_name,
    reference_database_version,
    reference_accession,
    coverage_percentage,
    sequence_identity
  ) %>%
  distinct()

# La taxonomia se une mediante muestra + contig. Si MMseqs2 ofrece varias
# asignaciones al rango mas especifico disponible, se conservan todas.
contig_taxonomy <- funcscan_arg %>%
  transmute(
    name = normalise_sample_name(sample_id_taxa),
    contig_id = contig_id_taxa,
    taxid,
    rank_label,
    scientific_name,
    mmseqs_lineage_contig
  ) %>%
  filter(!name %in% controls_list) %>%
  filter(!is.na(name), !is.na(contig_id)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(scientific_name)) %>%
  filter(scientific_name != "unclassified") %>%
  semi_join(
    clinical_sample_visits %>% select(name),
    by = "name"
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    rank_score = recode(rank_label, !!!rank_priority, .default = 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(name, contig_id) %>%
  filter(rank_score == max(rank_score, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  summarise(
    best_taxonomic_assignment = paste(
      sort(unique(scientific_name)),
      collapse = "; "
    ),
    best_taxonomic_rank = paste(
      sort(unique(rank_label)),
      collapse = "; "
    ),
    mmseqs_lineage_contig = paste(
      sort(unique(mmseqs_lineage_contig[!is.na(mmseqs_lineage_contig)])),
      collapse = " | "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

clinical_arg_taxonomic_context <- arg_hits %>%
  left_join(
    contig_taxonomy,
    by = c("name", "contig_id")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    clinical_sample_visits %>%
      select(name, sample, patient_id, follow_up_week),
    by = "name"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    best_taxonomic_assignment = replace_na(
      best_taxonomic_assignment,
      "No taxonomic assignment"
    ),
    best_taxonomic_rank = replace_na(
      best_taxonomic_rank,
      "No assignment"
    ),
    mmseqs_lineage_contig = replace_na(
      mmseqs_lineage_contig,
      "No lineage"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(patient_id, follow_up_week, ARG, contig_id, tool)

clinical_arg_taxonomic_context_summary <- clinical_arg_taxonomic_context %>%
  group_by(
    name, sample, patient_id, follow_up_week, ARG
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    tools_detecting_ARG = paste(sort(unique(tool)), collapse = "; "),
    n_tools = n_distinct(tool),
    n_ARG_contigs = n_distinct(contig_id),
    ARG_contigs = paste(sort(unique(contig_id)), collapse = "; "),
    taxonomic_context = paste(
      sort(unique(best_taxonomic_assignment)),
      collapse = "; "
    ),
    taxonomic_rank = paste(
      sort(unique(best_taxonomic_rank)),
      collapse = "; "
    ),
    lineage = paste(
      sort(unique(mmseqs_lineage_contig)),
      collapse = " | "
    ),
    min_coverage_percentage = min(coverage_percentage, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_sequence_identity = max(sequence_identity, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(patient_id, follow_up_week, ARG)

write_csv(
  clinical_arg_taxonomic_context,
  file.path(tables_dir, "clinical_ARG_taxonomic_context.csv")
)

write_csv(
  clinical_arg_taxonomic_context_summary,
  file.path(tables_dir, "clinical_ARG_taxonomic_context_summary.csv")
)

clinical_arg_taxonomic_context_summary
```

## Plot: cultivo vs taxonomia de los ARG detectados por funcscan

El panel superior mantiene la recuperacion metagenomica de las especies
cultivadas. En el panel inferior, los ARG detectados por ABRicate o
AMRFinderPlus muestran la mejor asignacion taxonomica del contig. Las
detecciones exclusivas de ARIBA se conservan, pero sin taxonomia de contig.

```{r culture-vs-funcscan-taxonomy-plot, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
taxonomic_code_key <- c(
  "Enterobacteriaceae" = "F-Ent",
  "Enterobacterales" = "O-Ent",
  "Gammaproteobacteria" = "C-Gam",
  "Shewanella" = "G-She",
  "Pseudomonas E putida E" = "S-Ppu"
)

taxonomic_context_to_code <- function(x) {
  map_chr(x, function(value) {
    if (is.na(value) || value == "") {
      return("?")
    }

    taxa <- str_split(value, ";\\s*")[[1]]
    codes <- unname(taxonomic_code_key[taxa])
    codes[is.na(codes)] <- "?"
    paste(unique(codes), collapse = "+")
  })
}

funcscan_ARG_taxonomy_heatmap <- 
  clinical_ARG_culture_metagenomics_by_method %>%
  filter(AMR %in% ARG_features_culture) %>%
  select(
    name,
    patient_id,
    follow_up_week,
    ARG = AMR,
    culture_gene_status,
    ariba_detected,
    funcscan_detected
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    clinical_arg_taxonomic_context_summary %>%
      select(
        name,
        ARG,
        ARG_contigs,
        taxonomic_context,
        taxonomic_rank
      ),
    by = c("name", "ARG")
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    sample_label = paste(patient_id, week_plot_labels(follow_up_week), sep = "\n"),
    feature_group = "Culture-reported ARG",
    feature = ARG,
    culture_status = case_when(
      culture_gene_status == "Reported" ~ "Reported by culture",
      culture_gene_status %in% c("Not determined", "Negative culture") ~
        "Not determined",
      TRUE ~ "Not reported by culture"
    ),
    status = case_when(
      culture_status == "Not determined" ~ "Not determined",
      culture_status == "Not reported by culture" ~
        "Not reported by culture",
      funcscan_detected & ariba_detected ~ "ARG recovered by ARIBA + funcscan",
      funcscan_detected ~ "ARG recovered by funcscan only",
      ariba_detected ~ "ARG recovered by ARIBA only",
      TRUE ~ "ARG not recovered by metagenomics"
    ),
    cell_label = case_when(
      culture_status == "Not determined" ~ "×",
      culture_status == "Not reported by culture" ~ "",
      !funcscan_detected & ariba_detected ~ "",
      !funcscan_detected ~ "",
      is.na(taxonomic_context) ~ "?",
      TRUE ~ paste0(
        taxonomic_context_to_code(taxonomic_context),
        "\n",
        ARG_contigs
      )
    )
  )

culture_funcscan_taxonomy_heatmap <- bind_rows(
  taxa_heatmap %>%
    transmute(
      sample_label,
      feature_group,
      feature,
      culture_status,
      status = case_when(
        culture_status == "Not reported by culture" ~
          "Not reported by culture",
        metagenomic_status == "Recovered cultured taxon" ~
          "Recovered cultured taxon",
        TRUE ~ "ARG not recovered by metagenomics"
      ),
      cell_label
    ),
  funcscan_ARG_taxonomy_heatmap
) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_label = factor(sample_label, levels = sample_levels_culture),
    feature = factor(
      feature,
      levels = rev(c(
        sort(unique(taxa_heatmap$feature)),
        sort(unique(funcscan_ARG_taxonomy_heatmap$feature))
      ))
    ),
    feature_group = factor(
      feature_group,
      levels = c("Cultured taxon", "Culture-reported ARG")
    ),
    culture_status = factor(
      culture_status,
      levels = c(
        "Reported by culture",
        "Not reported by culture",
        "Not determined"
      )
    ),
    status = factor(
      status,
      levels = c(
        "Recovered cultured taxon",
        "ARG recovered by ARIBA + funcscan",
      "ARG recovered by funcscan only",
        "ARG recovered by ARIBA only",
        "ARG not recovered by metagenomics",
        "Not reported by culture",
        "Not determined"
      )
    )
  )

culture_funcscan_taxonomy_colours <- c(
  "Recovered cultured taxon" = "#117733",
  "ARG recovered by ARIBA + funcscan" = "#CC79A7",
  "ARG recovered by funcscan only" = "#56B4E9",
  "ARG recovered by ARIBA only" = "#D55E00",
  "ARG not recovered by metagenomics" = "#DDCC77",
  "Not reported by culture" = "#D9D9D9",
  "Not determined" = "white"
)

# Filas invisibles que mantienen completas y separadas las dos leyendas.
funcscan_taxonomy_status_legend_dummy <- tibble(
  sample_label = factor(sample_levels_culture[1], levels = sample_levels_culture),
  feature_group = factor(
    "Culture-reported ARG",
    levels = c("Cultured taxon", "Culture-reported ARG")
  ),
  feature = factor(
    ARG_features_culture[1],
    levels = levels(culture_funcscan_taxonomy_heatmap$feature)
  ),
  status = factor(
    c(
      "Recovered cultured taxon",
      "ARG recovered by ARIBA + funcscan",
      "ARG recovered by funcscan only",
      "ARG recovered by ARIBA only",
      "ARG not recovered by metagenomics"
    ),
    levels = names(culture_funcscan_taxonomy_colours)
  )
)

funcscan_taxonomy_culture_legend_dummy <- tibble(
  sample_label = factor(sample_levels_culture[1], levels = sample_levels_culture),

plot_culture_vs_funcscan_taxonomy <- ggplot(
  culture_funcscan_taxonomy_heatmap,
  aes(x = sample_label, y = feature, fill = status)
) +
  # Matriz completa primero; el borde negro se superpone despues para que
  # las celdas adyacentes no oculten ninguno de sus lados.
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_tile(
    data = funcscan_taxonomy_status_legend_dummy,
    aes(x = sample_label, y = feature, fill = status),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha = 0,
    colour = NA,
    show.legend = c(fill = TRUE)
  ) +
  geom_tile(
    data = culture_funcscan_taxonomy_heatmap %>%
      filter(culture_status == "Reported by culture"),
    aes(x = sample_label, y = feature),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = NA,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 1.05,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = funcscan_taxonomy_culture_legend_dummy,
    aes(x = sample_label, y = feature, shape = culture_status_legend),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha = 0,
    show.legend = c(shape = TRUE, fill = FALSE)
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = cell_label),
    size = 2.65,
    lineheight = 0.85,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  facet_grid(feature_group ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = culture_metagenomics_y_labels) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = culture_funcscan_taxonomy_colours,
    limits = names(culture_funcscan_taxonomy_colours),
    breaks = c(
      "Recovered cultured taxon",
      "ARG recovered by ARIBA + funcscan",
      "ARG recovered by funcscan only",
      "ARG recovered by ARIBA only",
      "ARG not recovered by metagenomics"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Reported by culture" = 22,
      "Not reported by culture" = 22,
      "Not determined" = 4
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      order = 1,
      title.position = "top",
      nrow = 1,
      byrow = TRUE,
      override.aes = list(
        fill = unname(culture_funcscan_taxonomy_colours[c(
          "Recovered cultured taxon",
          "ARG recovered by ARIBA + funcscan",
      "ARG recovered by funcscan only",
          "ARG recovered by ARIBA only",
          "ARG not recovered by metagenomics"
        )]),
        colour = "grey70",
        alpha = 1
      )
    ),
    shape = guide_legend(
      order = 2,
      title.position = "top",
      nrow = 1,
      override.aes = list(
        shape = c(22, 22, 4),
        fill = c("white", "#D9D9D9", NA),
        colour = c("black", "#D9D9D9", "black"),
        alpha = 1,
        size = 4.5,
        stroke = 1.1
      )
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Culture results and taxonomic context of ARG contigs",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Contig taxonomy from ABRicate/AMRFinderPlus;",
      "ARIBA-only detections retained without taxonomy"
    ),
    x = "Patient and visit",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Metagenomic result",
    shape = "Culture-based status",
    caption = paste(
      "Taxonomic codes: F-Ent = Enterobacteriaceae (family);",
      "O-Ent = Enterobacterales (order);",
      "C-Gam = Gammaproteobacteria (class);",
      "\nG-She = Shewanella (genus);",
      "S-Ppu = Pseudomonas E putida E (species)."
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#E9EEF5", color = NA),
    strip.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", angle = 90, size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 11),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.box.just = "center",
    legend.justification = "center",
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.5)
  )

plot_culture_vs_funcscan_taxonomy
```
